g.text: W1 marks the verified scalar-feature conflict at frame 18. Wildfire has no matching named event in the requested reference figures.
Cyan in R: artificial negative barrier values from existing optimal filling; these are not negative observed FRP.
P/R share the complete fixed reference axis. A directional projection does not encode complete 2-D/3-D geometry. No baseline method panels are included.
